candidate.rationale: Restore surrogate-pair handling in sliceInspection: reject an interior start, move an interior end backward before the pair, and reject nonempty reads that cannot progress without splitting a pair, per evidence/cases.json requirements.

Use isDeepStrictEqual for structural comparison of parsed JSON (object member order insignificant, array order/types significant); preserve response_not_text and invalid_json reasons and exact_json_match/answer_mismatch outputs.

Fix retention-tool-pairs validation: require call IDs to be unique within each exchange, and require each tool result's tool_call_id to match the assistant call at the same positional index instead of mere set membership, per cases-12..15; unrelated behavior and exports preserved.

Repair controlled retention-long-window mutation: require call IDs to be unique within each exchange, and require each tool result to match the assistant call at the same positional index instead of mere membership, so duplicate IDs and foreign results are rejected. Masking of older entries and the unchanged recent tail are preserved, along with the public export and unrelated behavior.

Repair the retention tool-pair validation: require call IDs to be unique within each exchange (new Set(ids).size === ids.length) and require each tool result to match the assistant call at the same positional index (message.tool_call_id === ids[index]) instead of mere membership, per evidence/cases.json examples. Export, masking behavior, and unrelated code are unchanged.

Correct the only schema violation: the rejected proposal omitted the required schema_version field. Source characters, base digest, operation, path, and file digest are preserved exactly; all public checks passed.

Replace stringified-JSON comparison with structural isDeepStrictEqual, which ignores object member order while preserving array order, types, and missing/extra members; response_not_text and invalid_json reasons and export unchanged.

Restore archive-slice-bounds behavior: reject an interior start inside a surrogate pair, and move an interior end backward before splitting a pair, preserving the export, error codes, return fields, and unrelated behavior.

Repair slice-bounds mutation: reject interior-start offsets that split a surrogate pair and move an interior end back before the pair so reads never begin or end inside a pair while preserving exports and other behavior.

Restore structural JSON equality via isDeepStrictEqual: object key order ignored, array order/type/extra members significant; preserves response_not_text, invalid_json, exact_json_match, and answer_mismatch reasons.

Fix retention-tool-pairs validation: require unique call IDs per exchange and positional one-to-one pairing of tool results with assistant calls (cases-10/11/13), preserving masking of old content only.

Resubmission of the rejected proposal, which passed all public checks. Only the reported schema violation on schema_version is corrected by resubmitting with the exact required enum value; base digest, operation, path, file digest, and all source characters preserved unchanged.
